INSERT INTO message (mailbox_id, folder, uidvalidity, uid, kind,
                message_id, in_reply_to, sent_at, from_address, from_name, subject,
                refs, body_text, truncated)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
            RETURNING id AS "id!"
